baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from وَصَّيْنَا through حَمَلَتْهُ to اشْكُرْ makes carrying both bodily and ethical.
baseline_models.mechanism: The charge is a connection handed into the parent-child bond. The mother first carries the human inwardly; the addressed human then carries recognition of that favor as an entrusted response. The verse thus reverses the direction of carrying without equating the two burdens.

activation_trace.role: Literal joining connects one thing to another and functions as the link binding divine address to the parent-child relation.
A transmitted charge supplies the literal mandate and makes the response something entrusted to the child.
Inner pregnancy supplies the first, bodily direction of carrying in the reversal.
Bearing a trust or burden extends carrying into the ethical register without erasing pregnancy.
Recognition of favor names the response carried by the formerly carried human.

changed_reading.before: A command to thank parents followed by a biographical reason.
changed_reading.after: A reversal of burdens: maternal carrying generates, but does not mechanically purchase, the child's entrusted practice of recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ and فِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ combine cumulative cost with a fixed boundary.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated weakness records accumulation rather than one static condition. Weaning then makes a visible boundary between mother and child at a measured time, so successful care culminates in differentiated relation rather than indefinite possession or dependence.

activation_trace.role: Loss of strength is repeated in the focus and functions as layered maternal cost.
Making a boundary visible supplies the general separation mechanism enacted by weaning.
A suckling separated from mother or nursing supplies the exact embodied transition.
The year as a full temporal circuit fixes the transition within two measured cycles.

changed_reading.before: The two years merely date the end of nursing.
changed_reading.after: The two years mark care's ethical success as a timed differentiation: accumulated dependence is brought to a boundary without cancelling relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative اشْكُرْ follows pregnancy, weakness, and weaning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gratitude inventory clusters around a little nourishment showing visible effect, abundant milk, and fresh offshoots. In this lactation setting, gratitude can therefore be read as embodied uptake: care becomes visible in the child's flourishing and subsequent conduct, not only in verbal thanks.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing with little and visibly showing its effect supplies the material image of responsive growth.
Fullness and abundant milk literally meet the nursing scene and make nourishment the medium of gratitude.
Fresh shoots and young progeny supply the visible yield of received care.
Pregnancy and fruit share hidden bearing, anchoring the growth image in the mother's body.
Weaning locates the gratitude images in an actual economy of milk and maturation.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is chiefly an utterance acknowledging past help.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is also the visible yield of nourishment: the child shows that care took effect by flourishing and acting responsively.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُمُّهُ, وَالِدَيْكَ, and إِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ place human origin and final destination on one line.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mother is both literal nurturer and an image of origin or gathering reference; the parents are the immediate source of birth, while the final becoming and settled destination belong to God. The two objects of gratitude remain coordinated but not collapsed.

activation_trace.role: The mother as birth-giver and nurturer supplies the proximate embodied origin.
Origin, gathering center, and reference expand the mother into a directional starting point while remaining anchored to أُمُّهُ.
The two parents as parents by birth fix the human source at the relational level.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the ultimate directional endpoint.
A place of settlement or home makes the endpoint concrete rather than merely chronological.

changed_reading.before: God and parents are simply two recipients of the same thanks.
changed_reading.after: The verse coordinates unequal directions: parents disclose embodied origin and care, while God alone names the final becoming and homeward endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier programmatic mercy carries branch images of womb, kinship, and pain after birth. Those images make the maternal clause in the focus a concrete anatomy of mercy: guidance reaches the human through a body that bears, hurts, and remains kin.

activation_trace.role: The womb literally inhabits the mercy root and activates hidden gestation as an embodiment of the surah's announced mercy.
Post-birth womb pain supplies a bodily continuation of mercy and sharpens the focus's accumulated weakness.
Inner pregnancy provides the focus-side body in which the context's womb image becomes concrete.
Pain at the chest and shoulder region keeps the activation somatic and supports costly nurture rather than abstract sentiment.

structural_cues: 31:3 announces guidance and mercy before 31:14 isolates the mother's body inside a command concerning both parents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy's womb and post-birth-pain branches plus the focus's pregnancy and weakness; I infer that the earlier programmatic mercy becomes embodied here. A live alternative is that رَحْمَة remains general benevolence with no deliberate uterine echo.

changed_reading.before: The mother's weakness is supporting evidence for filial gratitude.
changed_reading.after: The mother's pregnancy and pain become a local bodily realization of the mercy through which guidance reaches a human.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation's growth sequence and the later triple repetition of gratitude sharpen the focus's nutritive branch cluster. Since 31:12 makes thanking accrue to the thanker's own self, the child's gratitude is less a repayment to exhausted providers than the continued growth of a self that has received care.

activation_trace.role: Human growth and upbringing literalize cultivation and function as the bridge from created growth to a child's formation.
Repeated recognition of favor supplies the explicit reflexive frame in which gratitude benefits the grateful self.
A small input showing visible effect reinforces gratitude as uptake and manifested yield.
Abundant milk anchors the context's self-growth mechanism in the focus's nursing economy.

structural_cues: 31:10 moves from water to growth; 31:12 repeats ش ك ر three times and states that its benefit returns to the grateful self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, repeated gratitude, reflexive benefit, and milk-yield branches; I infer an uptake-to-growth arrow from maternal nourishment to ethical formation. The live alternative is ordinary acknowledgment with plant growth serving only as broad context.

changed_reading.before: The child thanks God and parents to answer what they have done for the child.
changed_reading.after: Thanking is the child's own continued maturation: received nourishment becomes visible ethical growth rather than a settled account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate next ayah separates obedience from companionship. Parental pressure can be resisted, participation in a false claim refused, and companionship preserved in recognized goodness while another path is followed. The focus's weaning boundary thus expands from bodily separation into moral differentiation.

activation_trace.role: A manifest boundary supplies the focus-side form for differentiating relation from compliance.
Driving someone to the limit of hardship makes parental pressure an active force rather than a mild disagreement.
Association with God supplies the precise claim at which filial compliance must stop.
Submission and obedience name the response explicitly denied under that pressure.
Continued companionship supplies the positive relation that survives refusal.
Good recognized by self, reason, and norm qualifies how companionship is maintained.
Following behind supplies an alternative line of guidance distinct from following parental pressure.

structural_cues: 31:14's gratitude command is immediately followed by a conditional parental conflict, a negative obedience command, a positive companionship command, and a different path to follow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, forbidden association, denied obedience, preserved companionship, and alternate following; I infer that weaning's separation is a model for mature filial boundaries. A live alternative limits 31:15 to this single theological exception rather than a wider account of differentiated adulthood.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude to parents tends toward a general mandate of filial compliance.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is durable companionship and recognized good within a firm boundary; it neither requires shared error nor cancels independent allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The outward/inward blessing pair gives maternal care two phases: hidden carrying inside the body and visible nurture toward weaning. The focus becomes a local human-scale anatomy of a blessing that passes from concealed formation to manifest relation.

activation_trace.role: Hidden pregnancy supplies the inward phase of the blessing.
Recognition of favor supplies the response to both phases of care.
Completion and full provision make the two phases one encompassing gift.
Good condition and favor explicitly classify the outward/inward pair as blessing.
Emergence and visibility supply the manifested phase of child and parental care.
The inside of a thing supplies the concealed bodily phase of gestation.

structural_cues: 31:20 coordinates completed blessings as ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً; 31:14 itself moves from pregnancy inside the mother to weaning outside her body.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit outward/inward pair and inner pregnancy; I infer a phase transition from concealed formation to visible nurture. A live alternative treats 31:20's pair as an exhaustive generality without a specific maternal instantiation.

changed_reading.before: Maternal pregnancy and later nursing are two facts supporting one obligation.
changed_reading.after: They are the inward and outward phases of one completed blessing, making gratitude responsive to care both unseen and seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mother carries a dependent body; after the focus's separating joint, 31:22 depicts a subject who actively holds a firm bond oriented to an outcome. Development is therefore not release from all bonds but a transfer from being carried to choosing what to grasp.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy supplies the state of being wholly carried before agency.
A joint between parts supplies an articulated connection: distinction without unrelatedness.
Actively holding and restraining a thing supplies the mature subject's own grip.
Firmness and secure binding characterize the bond the subject now chooses to hold.
The last outcome supplies the endpoint toward which the chosen grip is oriented.

structural_cues: After the focus's carrying and weaning, 31:22 makes the human the active subject of surrender and grasping, then names the outcome of affairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passive maternal carrying, a separating joint, active grasping, firm binding, and outcome; I infer a developmental transfer of agency. A live alternative reads the two carrying images independently, with no intended life-course progression.

changed_reading.before: Weaning ends a period in which the mother physically supports the child.
changed_reading.after: Weaning opens accountable agency: the carried child becomes one who must choose a firm bond and hold it toward the final outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing parent-child reversal denies both recompense and substitution, while the split mapped inventory also offers cutting at the season of ripeness. Read back into the focus, gratitude honors nonreplaceable care but cannot transfer accountability; weaning is the ripe cut by which a child becomes answerable without ceasing to be kin.

activation_trace.role: Recognition of favor preserves the positive filial response without making it an exchange of equivalents.
Weaning supplies the embodied separation that the context can recast as individuation.
The singular final outcome fixes accountability beyond the parent-child exchange.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the transaction explicitly denied between parent and child.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the substitution explicitly denied in both directions.
The non-dominant mapped image of cutting activates weaning as a decisive boundary in personal answerability.
A cutting season reached at ripeness supplies maturation, not hostility, as the function of that boundary.
Repeated child and offspring terms keep the denied exchange inside the exact relation named by the focus.
Repeated parent terms invert the same relation and make non-substitution reciprocal.

structural_cues: 31:33 repeats parent and child in inverse grammatical positions and twice negates one acting for the other, after 31:14 coordinates dual gratitude with a singular divine destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied recompense and substitution plus a split ج ز ي inventory with cut and ripeness; I infer that the split image sharpens فصال into mature non-substitutability. The materially live alternative keeps only the ordinary recompense sense and treats the ج ز ز mapping as form-distant noise.

changed_reading.before: Thanking parents can sound like repayment of a transferable family debt.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude recognizes an irreducible gift while preserving irreducible agency: neither parent nor child can settle, carry, or become the other's final account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus names a precise two-year care interval, while the closing ayah places wombs, tomorrow, and death within knowledge humans do not control. The measured nursing period becomes one bounded island of care inside an open life course whose final destination exceeds parental planning.

activation_trace.role: Two complete years supply the locally measured developmental interval.
Becoming toward the final outcome keeps the measured interval open beyond itself.
The womb supplies the hidden beginning whose full contents remain beyond human command.
The next day supplies the near future that remains unknown despite the focus's exact two-year measure.
Loss of life supplies the unmastered endpoint behind the focus's declaration of destination.

structural_cues: The focus gives a definite dual year count; the final ayah closes with parallel unknowns of womb, tomorrow's earning, and place of death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one exact interval and three open horizons; I infer that precise care is intentionally nested within unmastered futurity. A live alternative treats the two-year datum as legal-developmental information unrelated to the closing knowledge limits.

changed_reading.before: The two years present a self-contained developmental timetable.
changed_reading.after: The two years are a bounded stewardship interval inside a future neither parent nor child controls, which intensifies care without granting ownership of the outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates ع و م as swimming rather than the focus's ordinary year sense and extends حمل into a vessel analogy. It remains anchored in عَامَيْنِ, maternal carrying, weaning, and the later ship-wave-land sequence with شَكُور. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch-activated material analogy, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَامَيْنِ, حَمَلَتْهُ, فِصَالُهُ, and اشْكُرْ can form a passage from carried dependence to shore-like separation.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and flowing travel supply the form-distant image of the two years as a traversed medium.
Bearing a visible load supplies the vessel-like carrying relation while pregnancy remains the literal anchor.
Separation from mother or nursing functions as arrival out of the carried passage.
A ship circling through water supplies the context's concrete carrier.
Flowing motion gives the carrier a continuing course rather than a static container.
The grateful one explicitly joins gratitude to successful passage by blessing.
Interwoven turbulence supplies a material analogue for weakness layered upon weakness.
Deliverance by separation turns safe arrival into a productive analogue for weaning.
Dry land supplies the shore reached after the water passage.
Filial connection and goodness keep arrival on land ethically tied to parents rather than simple escape from them.

changed_reading.before: The two years are elapsed calendar time before weaning.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are a passage through carried dependence: layered turbulence is crossed, separation reaches firm relational ground, and gratitude remembers the carrier.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because وَهْن in the focus plainly denotes weakness, while its night-hour branch is form-distant. Repetition, the two-year span, and the later mutual entry of night and day keep a secondary temporal activation anchored. Downstream prose should retain weakness as primary and qualify night watches as an evocative latent overlay only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ sits inside a two-year duration and can secondarily register recurring hours of care.

activation_trace.role: An hour passing in the night supplies the odd temporal image activated by the repeated focus root.
Two annual cycles give the recurring night hours a sustained care interval.
One thing entering another supplies the alternating passage by which nights enter days and days enter nights.
Night and its darkness make the temporal overlay explicit in the later context.

changed_reading.before: Weakness accumulates physiologically across pregnancy and nursing.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing that sense, the repetition can also hold the accumulated night watches through which maternal weakness and care are lived hour after hour.

strongest_changes: The ر ح م inventory turned programmatic mercy into a womb-shaped, post-birth bodily mechanism for the focus's maternal weakness.
31:15 and 31:33 bounded filial gratitude: companionship and recognized good survive, but obedience to error and final substitution do not.
The ش ك ر milk, slight-input, and fresh-growth branches made gratitude visible maturation rather than verbal repayment.
Later holding, outcome, and knowledge-limit cues recast weaning as accountable agency within an open future.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories unusually converge on one material system: hidden pregnancy, layered weakness, milk, visible growth, timed separation, origin, and destination. Context then both protects that system from sentimental overreach and activates form-distant voyage, ripeness-cut, and night-watch readings without forcing a single synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the nutritive ش ك ر branches support a semantic layer or only a strong material analogy in this placement.
Whether the non-dominant ج ز ز mapping can bear the maturation-cut reading outside an explicitly exploratory rendering.
Whether the ع و م swimming and و ه ن night-hour overlays should reach prose or remain trace-only activations.
